content.text: Gotta go on MLB Network today...What do you guys need to see from Zimmermann in sim game
Good Mechanics. Repeated delivery, good command/sharpness of his pitches.
If you see that, do you think he's gonna start again in the Reg season?
It's possible but no fin██ decision has been made. I will discuss with Brad and Dubee tomorrow after we check on how Zimmerman feels the day after.

Doing OK. Hitting off live pitchers but still sore.
